lead_raw_text:
The tetragonal phase Ba2Y4Cd2O12 (reduced formula BaY2CdO6) crystallizes in space group I4_1/d (No. 143), with 20 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Cd in octahedral O coordination, Y in a four-coordinate O environment, and Ba in a close-packed-like 12-neighbor arrangement, while each O center has two geometric neighbors. Polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Cd–Y octahedral polyhedra sharing corners and edges, and Ba–Cd polyhedra sharing corners, with a three-dimensional geometric neighbor graph spanning all 20 sites.
